## How to navigate?

|**Type**|**Details**|
|:-------|:----------|
|bigbook|a dynamic book where I add stuffs in a continuous manner and not in discrete articles.|
|brownpaper|tutorials or lecture notes on computational/theoretical chemistry and related topics|
|greenpaper|modern day research and my paper reading thoughts (**Opinions Warning!**)|
|bluepaper|notes on maths and physics|


::: {.callout-note}
All articles are downloadable in `.pdf` file format except bigbook and whitepaper. Please find the clickable <span class="badge bg-transparent text-dark border border-dark">Typst</span> button on the top-right side of each article.
:::

::: {.callout-important title="Disclaimer"}
[**The articles are solely written by me without any usage of large language models (LLM).**]{style="color:red;"}
